contentPattern: One row per link card. Cell 1: rich text - heading (title) and optional description paragraph. Cell 2: link (the card target; its text is used as fallback label). If only one cell is authored, the first link inside it becomes the card link. The whole card is clickable with a round arrow CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use for lists of navigational link cards with optional description. Options: light = horizontal grid of tall cards; alt and purple are color schemes. For cards with icons use cards-feature.
usageDescription: Stacked full-width link cards (policies, terms, related products) placed beside a section heading; the light option shows them side by side as tall cards with the arrow at the bottom.
